provenance.HEAD: 1d6f399d44f01926d0c93d4f4f8f0df4ac1b7b42
provenance.basis: Current working-tree source and five macros, including the uncommitted 900 mbar / 293.15 K material correction. No new detector initialization or simulation performed for this export.

target.name: CYGNO_gas
target.density_model: Ideal gas: rho = P * (x_He*M_He + x_CF4*(M_C+4*M_F)) / (Avogadro*k_Boltzmann*T). Molar masses come from Geant4 NIST elements at runtime.
target.mass_reference: Values previously queried from local Geant4 11.4.0 G4NistManager; natural-element abundances.
target.note: Use elemental atomic fractions, not the 60/40 molecular fractions, when supplying elemental target stoichiometry.

primaries.energy_unit: keV per ion (total kinetic energy, NOT keV/u)

physics.custom_max_step: DBL_MAX; no finite maximum set by these macros
physics.library_reference_version: Geant4 11.4.0; launcher defaults to $HOME/geant4/11.4.0. Branch name is not a version guarantee.
comparison_limitations: Sub-keV transport and the previously observed raw-energy excess require validation with the corrected gas.
Production range cuts and tracking energy thresholds are distinct quantities.

existing_QF.energy_argument: Hit pre-step kinetic energy in keV
existing_QF.hit_rule: For NR-selected hits: multiply raw deposit by QF(E) at E<=1 keV; by dRdE(E) at E>1 keV.
existing_QF.H1: Protons excluded from NR fields; total-energy branches retain raw proton deposits. Future integration must change this selection.
existing_QF.O16: NR selected but no fitted QF; current multiplier is unity.

ROOT_comparison.source_energy: tree1/Energy in MeV; multiply by 1000 for keV
ROOT_comparison.Geant4_hit_definition: total energy deposit minus non-ionizing deposit for NR-selected hits; total event branch adds raw non-NR deposits.
ROOT_comparison.raw_denominator_note: Dividing by energyDep_NR instead of initial energy defines a different diagnostic ratio.
ROOT_comparison.interpretation: Simulation-derived electronic-energy fractions, not calibrated detector charge/light yields.

requested_SRIM_export.QF_definition: Total electronic/ionization energy from the primary plus recoil cascade, divided by initial projectile energy. Specify the SRIM outputs/integrals used.
requested_SRIM_export.additional_energy_accounting: Preserve primary and recoil electronic contributions separately, uncertainty, escape/backscatter and non-overlapping energy balance where available.
requested_SRIM_export.methods: Label direct full-cascade TRIM, interpolated/density-scaled rows and SRModule stopping-power ratio proxies separately.
requested_SRIM_export.fit: Provide smooth QF(E) and d[E*QF(E)]/dE with fit/interpolation method, uncertainty and explicit boundary behavior. Preserve raw points; do not silently clip or extrapolate.
requested_SRIM_export.coverage: 0.25-1000 keV per ion. Hits can reach lower energies; state the below-grid policy. Report missing species/energies rather than inventing data.
requested_SRIM_export.integration: Proposed interchange format; this repository has no CSV QF loader yet.
